name: Gilead Sciences
catalyst: Beat and raise: adjusted EPS $2.55 vs about $2.17 expected, revenue $8.3B vs about $7.79B; 2026 product-sales outlook lifted to $31.0–31.3B; HIV sales up 18%.
risk: Cut its 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to −$1.20 to −$0.85 because of acquisition costs, and the stock was already near its highs before the report.
watch: Whether it holds the gap above $172 into the close while tech sells off.

name: Regeneron
target_note: No updated target read this sweep
catalyst: Strong third-quarter beat and a raised full-year outlook; one of the day's biggest gainers while tech sank.
risk: A 13% one-day jump can partly fade as traders take profits; biotech targets not yet updated.
watch: Whether it holds above the gap in the next few sessions.

name: Diamondback Energy
catalyst: Brent above $113 and heading for a fourth monthly gain as Houthi attacks target Saudi oil sites; Scotiabank ($250) and JPMorgan ($253) raised targets this month.
risk: Oil can reverse fast: WTI was $85 in late September, and any peace-deal headline would hit producers.
watch: Support near $195; resistance at $210, then $225. A third-quarter update is due in early November.

name: Microsoft
catalyst: Beat on revenue ($92.3B) and earnings; Azure grew 48%; free cash flow stayed positive and it trimmed its AI-spending outlook.
risk: It still trades with big tech, and rising Fed-hike odds plus AI-spending doubts are weighing on the whole group.
watch: A close back above about $530 (Thursday's close) would show buyers stepping in.

name: Nvidia
target_note: FactSet average; 96% of analysts rate it Buy
catalyst: Chip stocks are selling off after Intel's weak outlook, and big cloud spenders' cash-flow worries raise questions about AI-chip demand.
risk: Below its 50-day average (about $222), lower highs all month, and on track for its worst month since November 2025.
watch: A move back above the 50-day average before treating it as a dip to buy.

name: Alphabet
target_note: Targets being cut: 18 of 21 analysts lowered theirs
catalyst: Worst day since its 2004 IPO after a search-revenue miss and negative free cash flow of $9.07B.
risk: Heavy spending ($51.4B capex in the quarter) is being funded with debt and share sales; short-term sentiment is broken.
watch: Cheapest valuation in years (P/E about 15); wait for a base above the $270.70 52-week low.

name: Amazon
chg_label: Fri ~14:30 ET, off the premarket low
catalyst: Missed on EPS ($1.89 vs about $1.97) and revenue; quarterly capex hit $77.3B vs about $58.7B expected. AWS growth of 39% is the bright spot.
risk: Free cash flow is negative, the holiday-quarter outlook is below consensus, and spending rises again in 2027.
watch: Needs to rebuild above the $240 area it just lost.

name: Intel
catalyst: Third quarter beat ($0.52 vs $0.40 a share), but its fourth-quarter outlook missed on falling PC sales; worst day since 1974.
risk: About 30% one-day drop; the outlook cited a deep PC slump and a factory accident in Israel.
watch: No setup until the selling fades.
